findings.line: LocalAiTeammatePanelContent roster map: hardcoded `Idle · Read + propose`
findings.scenario: Roster is ready and the user submits; submission.kind becomes working and the form announces “Creating a bound local proposal…”. Every role still renders the static “Idle · Read + propose” line, and the help text still defines idle as “no process, provider, tools, lease, or budget is active.” Availability/effectClasses from the loaded roster are never read.
findings.remediation: Render availability/effectClasses from each teammate record; while submission.kind==='working', mark the in-flight teammate as working (not idle) and do not claim no process is active.

findings.scenario: POST 200 envelope has the pinned run/lane/notice/effects/schema/cost/teammate/task values but receipt.outputSha256=null, partialOutputSha256 set, and retryEligible=true. The client still treats it as kind:'result' and shows a terminal success receipt (“Output hash None”, “Retry eligible Yes”). route.test.ts only toMatchObject-partial-matches the API receipt and never asserts those fields; panel residualMismatches omit them too.
findings.remediation: Require outputSha256 64-hex, partialOutputSha256===null, retryEligible===false (and non-null job/input hashes) before kind:'result'; extend route and submit tests with those counterexamples instead of partial matchObject.

findings.scenario: A bound proposal arrives. Proposed-by, assigned task, and recommendation render outside the aria-live/atomic receipt. AT users get hashes/status announced and can miss the actual proposal text unless they later browse the section. Working progress is also only a sibling role=status, not referenced from the assignment controls.
findings.remediation: Put recommendation + assignment identity inside the same polite atomic live region as the receipt (or live-region the whole result). Point the textarea/select aria-describedby at the working status id while in-flight, matching the error association.

findings.line: rejects stale submit and roster completions…
findings.scenario: The named race test only calls isCurrentAiTeammateRequest/isCurrentAiTeammateRosterRequest. It never asserts a dataClass mismatch (the comparator’s fifth field) and never runs LocalAiTeammateRunPanel createProposal/reloadRoster overlapping completions. Dropping dataClass from the comparator, or dropping generation++ in onDataClassChange, still passes.
findings.remediation: Assert dataClass inequality returns false, and add a test that drives createProposal/reloadRoster with overlapping generations/runIds and expects discarded completions not to call setState.

audit.proof_assessment: Prior items are closed in the slice: POST authorizes before json/text, grants/effects fail closed, both Agent Studio panes stay mounted, working disables assignment controls, errors are labelled/described, UI submit pins run/lane/notice/effects/schema/cost/teammate/task, and fetch is unused on the happy POST path. The proof’s green vitest run is real but over-claims race/receipt closure: those oracles are helper/SSR substring checks, not overlapping in-panel completions or full receipt counterexamples. Full-suite timeout and stale E2E assistant labels are explicitly unfinished.
residual_risks: executeAiTeammateJobV1, AiTeammateRegistryV1Schema, AiTeammateRunReceiptV1Schema, and isLocalApiAuthorized are outside the slice; API 200 still forwards whatever the executor returns.
GET auth is not oracled (Host-only 200); removing the GET gate would not fail tests.
canSubmit does not require selectedTeammateId to be in the parsed roster; that is safe only if the registry schema cannot be empty/partial.
No fetch timeout/abort: a hung roster or POST leaves loading/working with no retry/cancel.
Workbench tool changes still unmount AgentStudioPanel; E2E still uses the old assistant label and does not axe Agent Studio viewports.
